title: population_lead
description: POPULATION-DISCOVERY-V1 (docs/25): a PopulationLead or CommunityLead. A lead is a place to LOOK, nominated by the corpus, the registry, the signal, prior field records or the open field. Authority is always LEAD: a lead never establishes current demand; only external field records instantiate it.

nominated_by.description: corpus row ids, seed ids, observation ids or search receipts that nominated this lead

community_key.description: e.g. a subreddit name, a hashtag, a forum

seed_population.description: true when the lead restates the population the signal itself named
